topic: Sources and Uses of Heat Energy
key_concepts: Heat energy is also called thermal energy
The sun is a source of heat energy
Stoves, ovens, and heaters are sources or devices that provide heat
Gas, oil, wood, coal, and electricity are common heat sources for cooking
Heat energy can cause changes such as cooking food, melting ice, and heating a room
Food coloring spreads faster in hot water than in cold water
Safety precautions are needed when handling heat energy sources and devices
Thermal energy can be conserved in households
Different communities may use different heat sources for cooking and heating
